patch_description: Merge the offset-YY entanglement block into the nearest-neighbor entangler by reusing the "ent_nn" parameter for YY gates instead of a separate "ent_off" parameter. This reduces the distinct parameter count from 7 to 6 while maintaining the same entanglement connectivity pattern (offset nearest-neighbor YY gates are structurally similar to XX gates and can share gradient flows). The consolidation improves parameter efficiency and tests whether tighter parameter coupling enhances worst-group margin while maintaining convergence speed and accuracy.
